title: New in Symfony 8.2: More Flexible Serialization Groups
content:
<html><head></head><body>Serialization groups let you choose which properties to include when
serializing an object. You might use one group for public API responses and
another for admin exports. Symfony 8.2 adds new ways to configure these groups,
and lets controllers and Messenger…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
